title: PoseLens Anatomy look: block table
description: Format of MUSCLES and MUSCLE_COLORS in apps/desktop/src/three/anatomy/muscles.ts. See docs/anatomy-spec.md. Lengths are rest-body metres (neutral sliders, 1.75 m) in the bone's local frame: +Y up, +X character's left, +Z front.

colors.description: Colour groups (MUSCLE_COLORS): group name -> 24-bit RGB as '#rrggbb' (0xrrggbb in code).

blocks.description: Blocks (MUSCLES), authored for the left side.

bone.description: Bone without side suffix. Central bones make one block (or an L/R pair with mirror: true); side bones always make <id>L and <id>R.

profile.description: Spindle profile. radius(t) = 0.5 * sin(pi*u)^ends, widest at t = peak.

id.description: Unique base id; L/R suffixes are added on placement.

center.description: Block centre in the bone's local frame (m).

size.description: Full extents along the spindle's local X, Y (long axis), Z before rotation (m).

rot.description: XYZ Euler rotation (rad), applied after scale.

mirror.description: Central bones only: also emit a mirrored right-side copy (negates center.x, rot.y, rot.z).
